rechecks.finding_ref: S7 requires an unstated per-tensor/all-terminal atomic BO rebinding operation and shared backend buffers make that invalid
rechecks.reason: The basis names and the candidate states the violated premise: the region has exactly one unaliased terminal output. Step 7 publishes only that terminal's fresh BO through ggml_fpga_residency_store/get_input and explicitly does not rebind the GGML tensor or its shared parent backend buffer, so an instance requiring all-terminal or buffer rebinding is outside the stated mechanism.

rechecks.finding_ref: timeout/reset/quiescence cannot both release staging safely and preserve prior BO validity
rechecks.reason: The basis identifies assumptions that contradict Step 7's timeout text: an unconfirmed abort quarantines the run and BO and disables subsequent backend work, with no release or device reset. The candidate also expressly disclaims request recovery and recoverable tensor continuity, so the release/reset/prior-validity conjunction is not part of the stated trace.
